افتتحنا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَتَحْنَا (iftataḥnā) /if.ta.taħ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اُفْتُتِحْنَا (uftutiḥnā) /uf.tu.tiħ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
